_about: United States: what a run's sources, units and words are. Read by scripts/jurisdiction.py. Measured 2026-11-04: data.sec.gov serves submissions and XBRL company facts (HTTP 200); www.sec.gov (the ticker list, filing documents) answers 403 without a declared user agent; Stooq now sits behind a JavaScript bot check and is not used; Nasdaq's quote API serves ten years of daily split-adjusted closes (unofficial); home.treasury.gov serves the daily par yield curve; no free S&P 500 total-return series was found.
name: United States
accounting: US GAAP (foreign private issuers: IFRS on Form 20-F)

filings.annual_report: Form 10-K (Item 1 business, 1A risk factors, 7 MD&A, 8 financial statements, 9A controls); 20-F for foreign private issuers
filings.results: Form 10-Q (quarterly); earnings releases on Form 8-K, Item 2.02
filings.governance: Proxy statement, DEF 14A (board, executive pay, related-person transactions, auditor)
filings.related_parties: Related-person transactions (Regulation S-K Item 404, in the proxy and the 10-K)

sources.facts: scripts/edgar.py facts (XBRL company facts, us-gaap, data.sec.gov)
sources.prices: scripts/edgar.py prices (Nasdaq quote API: unofficial, split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted)
sources.structured: none yet: proxy voting results come from 8-K Item 5.07

risk_free.source: home.treasury.gov daily par yield curve (scripts/edgar.py treasury)

benchmark.name: S&P 500 (SPY price return)
benchmark.source: Nasdaq quote API; no free total-return series was found, so dividends (about 1.5 % a year) are left out and outcome comparisons say so

regulators.courts: federal and state courts; SEC enforcement releases

vocabulary.related_party_approval: audit committee review of related-person transactions (Item 404)

user_agent: SEC asks every automated client to declare who it is: set EQUITY_RESEARCH_USER_AGENT to a name and contact address before a US run (netfetch.py sends it to sec.gov only)
status: built and tested on stored real EDGAR data; no US run has been made
